text:
Aisha: Heads-up: NovaHealth is live on the Azure Marketplace with a co-sell listing and a Dedicated Reserved pilot committed for 12 months. Huge win — HIPAA scope + private VPC onboarding next week. Details: https://intranet.redwood.com/deals/NovaHealth (internal)
Raj: Amazing!! Congratulations team 🎉. Did they sign the dedicated capacity contract or is it a pilot/PO?
Aisha: It's a signed MSA + PO for dedicated capacity (monthly commit). Pilot starts next Mon for 3 months, then auto-convert to committed if thresholds met. CTO requested on-prem option for some workloads.
Cam: Nice. Signals we should prep a dedicated deployment runbook for their compliance team. I'll ping eng to prep a private deployment checklist.
Ben: @Cam I'll prep the on-prem packaging notes and list of telemetry we can disable for air-gapped. Also checking quant profiles for LLM64-med to reduce GPU usage.
Marta: Marketing: can we get a short quote from NovaHealth's Head of Data by EOD Friday? We'll do a co-marketing case study and announce on blog + social. @Aisha assigning you as lead.
Aisha: Yup, meeting set on Thurs with their CDO. I'll try to lock a quote and a 1-2 line soundbite. Would love a product highlight: lowered per-token cost by >30% via caching/batching.
sales-bot: Deal closed notification: Opportunity #4521 closed-won by Raj. ARR impact: $1,200,000.
Samir: Please include HIPAA addendum and SOW attachments in the internal deal folder. I'll review the on-prem security matrix.
Aisha: Folder: https://drive.redwood.com/teams/partnerships/novahealth
Cam: Can Eng do a canary rollout plan for their initial region? Suggest region: eastus2. @Ben
Ben: Yep — will create canary config and capacity plan. ETA Tue.
Marta: Once we have the quote + 1x screenshot, marketing will draft the blog. Will loop in design for hero asset. :rocket:
Aisha: Thank you everyone — huge cross-functional effort. Will post a postmortem-style onboarding doc after week 1.
